prompt: A bearded line cook with an undercut and a short top knot, both arms covered in full tattoo sleeves and a small fox tattoo on the side of his neck, wearing a black t-shirt and a stained kitchen apron, stands in the center of a wrecked restaurant kitchen pointing a big steel serving fork straight at the viewer, with a calm, cocky half smile and one raised eyebrow. Around his feet three cartoon thugs in hoodies lie knocked out on the tile with cartoon stars circling their heads, one of them face down in a spilled pot of spaghetti. A pan still smokes on the stove behind him under hanging copper pots, and steam curls up past his shoulders. Bold comic illustration with thick black ink linework, sharp expressive faces and saturated colors of tomato red, teal and mustard yellow, with a plain empty strip of dark wall across the top quarter.
